title: Simulation and fault injection: SITL, MAVLink and NAVERA's simulator
summary: How a software-in-the-loop simulator closes the loop between NAVERA and a real autopilot: MAVLink frames byte by byte, the simulator's sensor models (Gauss–Markov noise, Rayleigh errors), and a recorded fault-injection campaign turned into measurements and PASS / FAIL verdicts — with an optional scripted run of your own.
